artDirection: Photorealistic podcast-studio photography. Warm tungsten key light with a soft teal/cyan LED accent rim; shallow depth of field; medium close-up at a warm wood table with a broadcast microphone; blurred shelving, books and plants in the background. Brand palette: teal #0F766E, gold #D4A017, cream #F4EFE4, warm wood. 50mm look, high detail, editorial quality. Every subject wears their brand accent colour. Keep the same framing, lighting and palette across the whole cast and every scene plate so the episode reads as one coherent show.

characters.name: سامي
characters.bio: مقدّم عربي دافئ. يشرح، يصحّح بلطف، ويدير التدريب.
characters.look: Man in his 30s, Middle-Eastern features, short dark hair, light stubble, warm confident half-smile. Wears a teal band-collar henley shirt (brand teal #0F766E). Seated at a warm wood podcast table with a broadcast microphone, warm lamp-lit shelving and plants behind.

characters.name: Maya
characters.bio: معلمة من كاليفورنيا. صوت واضح، ودود، غير مسرحي.
characters.look: Woman in her late 20s / early 30s, long wavy warm-brown hair, hazel eyes, bright genuine smile. Wears a mustard-yellow ribbed knit sweater (brand gold #D4A017). Seated in a warm podcast studio with a broadcast microphone, teal accent lighting and soft bokeh plants behind.

characters.name: Omar
characters.bio: مصمم من نيويورك. نبرة محادثة، مختلفة بوضوح عن مايا.
characters.look: Man in his early 30s, short curly dark hair, trimmed beard, warm friendly smile. Wears a dark navy button-up shirt with a subtle teal chest-stripe pocket accent (nod to brand blue #0284C7). Seated in a warm podcast studio with a broadcast microphone, warm lamp and shelving behind.
